<script>
// Function to handle the password prompt and redirect
function accessWorkshopMaterials() {
  const correctPassword = "CostaMesa2025"; 
  const targetPage = "workshop-materials.html";

  // Check if content is already unlocked for the session
  if (sessionStorage.getItem('ncura_materials_authenticated') === 'true') {
    window.location.href = targetPage;
    return;
  }
  
  const password = prompt('This section requires a password. Please enter it to continue:');

  if (password === correctPassword) {
    // Set a session flag so the user is not prompted again during this session
    sessionStorage.setItem('ncura_materials_authenticated', 'true');
    // Redirect to the protected page
    window.location.href = targetPage;
  } else if (password !== null) { // Check if user pressed cancel (password is null)
    alert('Access Denied. Incorrect password. Please try again or ask a workshop assistant.');
  }
}
</script>

::: {.text-center}
# NCURA Regional Conference Workshop
:::

## Workshop Overview

Welcome to the NCURA Regional Conference Workshop! This page contains resources and information for attendees participating in the Vandalizer workshop.

### **Access the Workshop Instance**

**[Click here to access the Vandalizer workshop instance $\rightarrow$](https://ncura2.insight.uidaho.edu/){target="_blank"}**

::: {.callout-important}
**IMPORTANT - Keep this link open in your browser during the workshop!**

The workflow sharing links (found in the Workshop Materials section below) will only work if you have the Vandalizer instance open in another tab or window. Additionally, these workflows are configured specifically for this instance and will only function during the conference period (available for the next 4 days).
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
**Security Note**: These instances run on University of Idaho infrastructure and access cloud services. **Please do not upload sensitive information.**
:::

### Learn More About Vandalizer

Interested in implementing Vandalizer at your institution? Visit **[AI4RA at University of Idaho](https://ai4ra.uidaho.edu/){target="_blank"}** to sign up for updates, learn more about the project, and explore what the University of Idaho and Southern Utah University are up to.

---

## Test Files (Public)

The following test files are provided to allow for low-risk experimentation with the Vandalizer system. **No password is required to download these files:**

1. **[Sample NOFO](https://github.com/ui-insight/vandalizer-manual/raw/main/test-files/Sample_NOFO.pdf){download="Sample_NOFO.pdf"}**
   - A Notice of Funding Opportunity document showing typical grant announcement requirements and guidelines
   
2. **[Sample Grant](https://github.com/ui-insight/vandalizer-manual/raw/main/test-files/Sample_Grant.pdf){download="Sample_Grant.pdf"}**
   - A completed grant proposal demonstrating standard sections and formatting

3. **[Sample Budget](https://github.com/ui-insight/vandalizer-manual/raw/main/test-files/Sample_Budget.xlsx){download="Sample_Budget.xlsx"}**
   - A budget spreadsheet with line items and budget justification

4. **[Sample RFA](https://github.com/ui-insight/vandalizer-manual/raw/main/test-files/Pilot%20Grant%20RFA.pdf){download="Pilot Grant RFA.pdf"}**
   - A Request for Application document outlining submission requirements and evaluation criteria

5. **[Award Announcement](https://github.com/ui-insight/vandalizer-manual/raw/main/test-files/award_announcement.pdf){download="award_announcement.pdf"}**
   - An award notice detailing funding amounts, terms, and compliance requirements
